name: Node.js with package managers
description: Install Node.js (checksum verified) with npm plus your choice of pnpm, yarn and bun.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js version: 'lts', 'latest', a major version such as '22', or an exact version such as '22.11.0'.

pnpm.description: pnpm version: 'none' to skip, 'latest', or a version such as '10.4.1'.

yarn.description: Yarn version: 'none' to skip, 'latest' (or 'berry') for modern Yarn, 'classic' for Yarn 1.x, or a version such as '4.5.0' or '1.22.22'.

bun.description: Bun version: 'none' to skip, 'latest', or a version such as '1.2.0'.
